name: B. F. Reynolds
role: Texas cattleman trailing a herd north in 1885
bio: B. F. Reynolds arrived from Texas in July 1885 and made Medora his headquarters while 4,500 Texas cattle were on the trail near Rapid City. His brother, of Albany, Texas, joined him in August, and B. F. took charge when the cattle reached Mingusville in fine condition at the end of August.

moments.label: Arrived from Texas with 4,500 cattle on the trail
